name: 万华化学

steps: decode each annual_trace.data using lzma and base64
place complete annual records by year, then scenario_order
preserve all other original metadata and JSON key order
restore: canonical UTF8 JSON each annual array; check its SHA256
lzma.compress(array,preset=6) and base64 restores each original data string
canonical original JSON plus one LF; check original_bytes and original_sha256

expand: python 2026-Q3.py --expand [target]; default expanded-output.json; restores original bytes exactly, without economic recomputation
expand_years: python 2026-Q3.py --expand-years [target]; default expanded-years.json; original parsed fields plus every scenario.years as readable records

summary.classification: core plus explicitly labelled stress/exit diagnostics
